Class WindowState

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.WindowState
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class WindowState extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Stores named values for one window, such as a counter, selected tab, or text field value.

Each new window receives its own copy of the defaults. Navigation within that window keeps these values until the window closes. Use this store on the client thread; attempts to use it after closure fail. It stores simple values that cannot be changed in place. Mutable objects captured separately by a script are still shared script data and are not protected by this store.
